reason: I already make my own syrups and rhums arrangés from péi fruit for a few euros a litre, and the owner goes through the drinks costs every quarter. I'd ask for the free sample out of curiosity, but I wouldn't put in a paid order this month.
objection: 23 euros a litre is a lot next to what my homemade syrups cost me, and I can't see yet what a fermented Koso does in a glass that my own syrup doesn't.
would_change_my_mind: Tasting the sample and finding a flavour I genuinely can't make in-house, with a cost per cocktail low enough that the owner signs off at the quarterly review.
